'''''TIV Z766/2''''' was a [[Traffic Interdiction Vessel]] used by [[Prudii Skirata|Null-5]] and [[Atin Skirata|RC-3222]] during their mission to [[Olanet]]. It was piloted by [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[Five-Seven]].
